other_conditions: Applicant must be born in Goa or have been a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years
If resident for fifteen years, applicant must have been educated in Goa for a continuous period of at least seven years
At least one parent must be born in Goa and resident in Goa for the last fifteen years, or one parent must have resided in Goa for the last twenty‑five years
Special provision for Tillari Irrigation Project affected persons: a Collector certificate can relax the domicile requirement
Unmarried beneficiaries are those who attain the age of majority (18) on or after 01‑04‑2012; married beneficiaries are those who were 18 before 01‑04‑2012 and are aged 19–45 as of 01‑04‑2016
Application must be submitted within one year of attaining age 18 or within one year of civil marriage registration
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000, either as a bank fixed deposit for unmarried beneficiaries or as a cash payment for married beneficiaries, up to age 45.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Collector certificate (if applicable for Tillari Irrigation Project beneficiaries)
